vectors.name: synthesized_defaults_v12
vectors.why: Every field this version declares, at its protocol default. Synthesized so the message is held to Apache Kafka's bytes at all; hand-written cases carry the interesting shapes.

vectors.name: a_nullable_string_tag_carries_a_value
vectors.why: `ClusterId` is tag 0 and nullable with a null default, so it is absent unless set. Present, its payload is a compact nullable string — the tagged section exists only in flexible versions, so there is no legacy form to choose between.
